schema_description: Hugging Face Hub model repository files: the chat template (ATEM channels: to=self reasoning, to=user answer, to=<tool> calls), the tokenizer config with its response_template (the model's declared output fields), and the model config.
notes: A reasoning-channel model. Its first cohort run (vLLM v0.30.0, no --reasoning-parser, 2026-09-28) answered every case right and scored every case wrong: vLLM returned the whole generation as content with the channel markers stripped. The planner reads these files to name the engine's muse_glimmer reasoning parser and the request's reasoning_strength.
